verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime: you start it on your own machine via a single binary or Docker, serve the API at localhost:8080, and run models locally. It needs no GPU and treats the CPU path as a tested, first-class option, so inference stays on-device. missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that prompts and data never leave the device or that it works fully offline (model and backend downloads come from the internet), and independent hands-on corroboration of local-only operation.
